visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women sit side-by-side on stools in a minimalist indoor setting with warm, low-level lighting. One woman on the left wears a light beige button-down shirt and blue jeans, holding a smartphone. The woman on the right wears a grey jacket over a white tank top and blue jeans. Behind them is a simple wall, a dark green poster, and a warm-toned lamp. (2) The scene shifts through various cuts of the two women interacting, laughing, and gesturing toward each other. They exhibit expressive facial movements, squinted eyes during laughter, and frequent hand movements to emphasize their conversation. Occasional screen-recorded clips of one woman with a black bar over her eyes appear briefly. (3) A woman is seen indoors at a round wooden table. She reaches into a black leather bag, pulls out a white mug, and pours white powder from a pink sachet into it. The lighting is soft and natural from a nearby window. (4) The visuals transition to several selfie-style shots of the woman. She is seen smiling in a car with a sunroof, posing outdoors in a park wearing sunglasses, and taking mirror selfies. (5) High-detail product shots feature pink and white boxes labeled 'Milcolla' and individual sachets. A close-up shows the white granular powder on a wooden dish. (6) The final sequence shows the woman drinking from a blue mug, looking refreshed, followed by product boxes displayed against a soft pink background with promotional text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy conversational speech between two females, accompanied by a bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat. Frequent bursts of laughter and high vocal arousal are present. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition. The dialogue continues with a rapid speech rate as they play a Q&A game. Vocal pitch varies significantly, indicating playfulness and excitement. (3) A subtle change in acoustic texture occurs as the BGM volume dips slightly to allow for a clearer narration. The sound of plastic rustling and a soft liquid pour is heard as the powder sachet is opened and mixed. (4) Digital UI 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects coincide with the appearance of on-screen text slogans. The vocal tone shifts to a professional yet friendly narrative style, explaining product benefits. (5) Sparkling SFX elements are added as the music swells for the final brand reveal. The primary speaker's voice remains clear and enunciated against the rhythmic background track until the fade-out.
